name: United Microelectronics Corporation
business_model: Pure-play foundry focused on mature and specialty nodes (22/28nm and above); fabs in Taiwan, Singapore, China and Japan.

name: GlobalFoundries Inc.
business_model: Pure-play specialty foundry (RF, FD-SOI, silicon photonics, mature nodes); about 81% owned by Mubadala; incorporated in the Cayman Islands, principal offices in Malta, New York.

name: Hua Hong Semiconductor Limited
business_model: Specialty pure-play foundry (embedded NVM, power discretes, analog/PMIC) with 8-inch and 12-inch fabs in Shanghai and Wuxi; operating subsidiary HHGrace. Controlled by Shanghai Huahong (Group); TrendForce's 'HuaHong Group' also includes HLMC (Huali Micro), which the listed company proposed to acquire.

name: Tower Semiconductor Ltd.
business_model: Specialty analog foundry (RF, SiGe, silicon photonics, power, image sensors) with fabs in Israel, the US and Japan.

name: Vanguard International Semiconductor Corporation
business_model: Specialty 8-inch foundry (high-voltage, BCD, SOI, discrete, DDIC/PMIC) in Taiwan and Singapore; building a 12-inch fab with NXP (VSMC).

name: Powerchip Semiconductor Manufacturing Corporation
business_model: Taiwanese foundry offering logic and memory (DRAM/flash) foundry services; also sells memory, which TrendForce excludes from its foundry ranking.

name: Nexchip Semiconductor Corporation
business_model: Hefei-based 12-inch foundry focused on display driver ICs, CIS and PMICs; entered TrendForce's top 10 in 4Q21.

name: Mubadala Investment Company PJSC
business_model: Abu Dhabi sovereign investor; majority owner of GlobalFoundries.
